supplemental_mutation_method: Execute each single production-line replacement in the imported module namespace before the targeted pytest run; restore original module definitions in finally. Production source files are never written. Assert source bytes are identical before and after each run.
supplemental_runner:
import hashlib

import pytest

from populace_dynamics.engine import forward_earnings_s1_v1 as s1

check = next(c for c in record["supplemental_checks"] if c["check_id"] == sys.argv[1])
source = Path(check["source"])
original = source.read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(original).hexdigest() == check["restored_source_sha256"]
old = check["old"].encode()
assert original.count(old) == 1
mutated = original.replace(old, check["new"].encode(), 1)
try:
    exec(compile(mutated, str(source) + "::<supplemental_mutant>", "exec"), s1.__dict__)
    exit_code = pytest.main([
        "-p", "no:cacheprovider", "-q", "-s",
        "--basetemp=/private/tmp/s1-supplemental-mutation-" + check["check_id"],
        check["failed_tests"][0],
    ])
finally:
    exec(compile(original, str(source), "exec"), s1.__dict__)
    assert source.read_bytes() == original
raise SystemExit(exit_code)
